items.title: Validate parallel multi-agent dispatch with isolated receipts
items.context: Prove Lattice can coordinate multiple parallel fake/host dispatches for disjoint scopes, keep work isolated, collect separate receipts, and produce a combined review/merge plan without auto-merging or claiming DONE.
items.userSees: `lattice dispatch_run --host=fake --parallel=2 --json` returns two worker dispatches, two receipts, combined status=accepted_local, productionDone=false.

happy.desc: parallel fake dispatch creates two isolated worker dispatches with separate accepted-local receipts.

edge.desc: one worker failing leaves combined status diagnostic/partial and preserves the passing worker receipt.

adversarial.desc: parallel workers with overlapping or denied scopes cannot be auto-merged or productionDone.
